paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作部分简要提及了[23]，将其归类为使用压电薄膜和毫米波信号的语音窃听方法，但并未将其作为主要对比或使用对象，属于普通相关文献引用。

evidences.evidence_quote: [23] proposed a speech eavesdropping approach by leveraging the piezoelectric films and mmWave signals.
evidences.evidence_context: In other similar research, [21] and [22] use mmWave radar to recover audio below 1 kHz, but the performance of the human audio reconstruction has not been evaluated. mmSpy [18] can eavesdrop on phone calls by using mmWave and machine learning. However, mmSpy studies eavesdropping on constrained vocabulary (hot words and numbers). Authors in [17] used mmWave to acquire high-quality voice from user’s vocal vibrations from near-throat region. [23] proposed a speech eavesdropping approach by leveraging the piezoelectric films and mmWave signals. [24] proposed a remote and through-wall screen attack that used mmWave to remotely collect information from LCD screens.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang et al., "mmPhone: Acoustic eavesdropping on loudspeakers via mmWave-characterized piezoelectric effect," in Proc. IEEE Conf. Comput. Commun., 2022, pp. 820–829.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 该引用出现在普通相关工作列举段落中，未对目标论文的具体能力（如亚毫米级、RFID、through-wall）进行任何描述或认可，属于普通引用。且目标论文标题包含'RFID'和'sub-mm'，但引用中未体现这些关键词。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
